notes: Wording and layout sweep aligned with HeishamonNR-update-tab (v4.12.9/4.12.10): the Update status field speaks the same sentence templates ("Bridge update available: X.Y.Z. Press [Update from GitHub]." / "Up to date (X.Y.Z)."), the boot sentence is "Running bridge version 1.3.1.", the Update group and status fields use the update tab widget style, updater errors are full sentences with a named button, and the test harness is now committed. No publisher or updater logic change. v1.3.1 adds a dashboard-family guard to the self-updater: an update whose ui-* config node types belong to the other dashboard package (DB1 <-> DB2) is refused before deploy, so the Update button can never move the tab out of the current menu.
